discussion.body: Build study, not clothes. Same face as the existing Ysolde plate (Tierso Life cleric-alchemist, dark hair with sticks). Softer scholar-healer build, not a soldier. Linen wrap tunic and shorts. Graphite flattened her warmth; cloth pass should keep the medium-brown skin of the painted plate. Local: artifacts/Concept art/FEAT-034-ysolde-rhea-build-study.jpg. Existing clothed plate stays.
